thread:
Maya S.: Heads-up: planning to deprecate bench-sentry (the old per-model smokewatch agent). Need opinions on compatibility path and what to keep for incrementally migrating bench probes. TL;DR: unify into prober-service and remove legacy hooks by EOW next quarter.
Ethan K.: Is there telemetry we need to preserve? bench-sentry emits per-shard latency histograms we still surface in console.
Priya R.: We can replay histograms from prober-service but schema is different. Need mapping rules. Also gate checks rely on bench-sentry's golden sample tagging.
Jason L.: Proposal: add a compatibility shim that translates bench-sentry metrics -> prober schema for 6mo. Small adapter binary. @Maya S. thoughts on rollout?
Maya S.: Yes, adapter makes sense but we should avoid long-term maintenance. Timebox: 6 months max. Add a lint that flags configs that still reference bench-sentry.
Sam T.: How disruptive for onboarding pipeline? The ingest stage expects bench-sentry probe artifact 'sentry.meta' in model bundle.
Priya R.: We can accept both: prober-service writes 'prober.meta' and adapter emits 'sentry.meta' during transition. But need to update intake validators.
Ethan K.: We should also add an eval regression test: if adapter is on, assert no metric drift > 5% between prober and shim. Otherwise we silently miss regressions.
Jason L.: Agree. Implementation notes: adapter as a sidecar in intake jobs. Lightweight, Rust binary ~2MB. Can ship in next sprint.
Maya S.: :thumbsup: add feature flag 'bench_sentry_compat' and default true for 3 months then false. Ops to flip per-customer if issues.
Iris-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed prober-service v2.4.3 to staging (sha:abc123). Observability links: https://ops/redwood/prober/abc123
Sam T.: Question: what about golden sample IDs? We need stable canonicalization. My suggestion: create GUID namespace mapping and store mapping in model-registry metadata.
Priya R.: Good call. We'll add 'legacy_ids' array to registry entries and migration job that writes mappings. Migration can run offline.
Ethan K.: Runtime compatibility: runtime bench harness uses bench-sentry log format for quick-lint. We'll add small parser to compatibility lib.
Jason L.: Action items I can take: write adapter prototype, add flag hooks, draft runbook for rollback. ETA 10 business days.
Maya S.: I'll own validators update and lint. Priya, can you handle registry migration? Ethan, please own telemetry assertions. Sam, runbook + oncall drill.
Sam T.: I'll schedule a 30min dry-run with eng-sre next week. @everyone add any edge cases here.
Priya R.: Edge case: air-gapped private deployments - adapter needs to be included in private bundle. Flag that in the RFC.
Maya S.: Noted. We'll include packaging step in release checklist. Thanks all — hope to post RFC follow-up with timelines by Friday.
